gitCommit.subject: Lalamove: cancel a booking while it is still finding a driver (#440)
gitCommit.body:
Lalamove: cancel a booking while it is still finding a driver (#440)

cancel-shipment only accepted shipper_status='booked', a state a Lalamove
booking never enters (it goes straight to 'assigning_driver'), so Lalamove was
uncancellable and an unaccepted booking stranded the order for Lalamove's
two-hour auto-cancel with no way to rebook elsewhere.

- New shared canCancelCourierBooking(): NinjaVan/SPX while 'booked',
  Lalamove while 'assigning_driver'. Read by the route AND all three dispatch
  tiles so the button never offers what the server refuses.
- Lalamove In-Transit tile gains "Cancel booking" → order returns to Awaiting
  Booking (order not cancelled, inventory untouched). on_going not offered.
- Consolidated multi-stop trips: one shared booking, so every order on the
  trip is reset (batch fields cleared, each cached receipt invalidated).
- Morning routine: A5 → thirty-seven folded; agenda shifted to 2026-10-04.

iOS: none (admin route + admin page + pure lib). No migration.
